verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library with a well-documented programmatic API (pipeline.run(), pipeline.dataset(), CLI, decorators) that an AI-native user/agent can drive directly in code, plus an official MCP server (dlt-mcp) and AI harness for agent-driven pipeline building. However, there's no traditional REST/OpenAPI-based public API for the product itself (openapi probe returned 404s), so 'documented public API' is really the Python SDK/CLI rather than a hosted web API. missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST API spec for the product itself, independent hands-on validation of the MCP server or Python API being agent-driven, and confirmation the CLI/API surface is stable/versioned for programmatic external control.
